note: Fuzzer-controlled bytes are written to a temporary FLAC file and then parsed by the real flac CLI implementation.
The generated argv selects the fuzzed file as the input to the command-line decoder path.
The decoder assumes the STREAMINFO MD5 field is initialized and uses it to decide whether MD5 checking stays enabled; malformed metadata can leave this state inconsistent.
This state transition controls whether later decoding will compare against the computed MD5 sum.
Later decoding reaches the MD5 verification sink, where the uninitialized/invalid decoder state is consumed during comparison and triggers the benchmark condition.
